BEFORE YOU COME DOWNSTAIRS

Basement Terms of Service

Version 2026-10-18.1 · Effective October 18, 2026

These terms explain the rules for using Basement and how its current features work. Please read them before checking the agreement box and entering.

1. Your agreement

These terms govern your use of the Basement website, its downloadable shortcut, and its app features (the Service). Basement is independently operated by its owner, Eli. In these terms, we and us refer to the owner operating Basement, and you refers to the person using it.

By checking the agreement box and entering, you agree to the version shown above. If you do not agree, do not enter or use the Service. Reading these terms does not check the box or enter the app for you.

2. All ages and parent or guardian involvement

Basement is intended to be available to people of all ages where permitted by law. If you cannot legally agree to these terms on your own, a parent or legal guardian must review them and authorize your use where required. All-ages eligibility does not mean every linked website or item is appropriate for every age; parents and guardians should supervise minors' use.

Where applicable law requires parental notice or verifiable parental consent before collecting a child's personal information, those requirements must be met separately before that collection. A child's checkbox, a visitor name, or a statement that a parent gave permission does not itself verify parental consent. Contact the owner about a child's use or data.

3. Permitted use and basic rules

Use Basement lawfully and respect other people, content owners, and the rules of your school, workplace, device owner, and network. In particular:

  • Do not harass, threaten, impersonate, expose someone's private information, or distribute unlawful or exploitative material.
  • Do not attempt unauthorized access, steal staff credentials, distribute malicious code, interfere with the Service, or deliberately overload its systems.
  • Access, watch, download, copy, or share content only when you have the necessary permission or another lawful basis.
  • A listed proxy or other link does not give permission to disregard school, workplace, network, or third-party rules.

4. External websites and content rights

Basement organizes links to games, media, Google Drive files, proxies, and other services. Those services are operated by third parties and may have separate terms, age restrictions, advertising, downloads, charges, and data practices. A listing does not establish that content is licensed, safe, accurate, available, or suitable for you, and it does not grant permission to copy it.

Basement does not guarantee anonymity or protection from monitoring when you use a proxy. School or device restrictions can still apply. The owner may remove links after a rights, safety, or availability concern is reported.

Creators retain their rights in their content. These terms do not transfer ownership of games, media, artwork, software, or third-party materials to Basement or its users.

5. Visitor names and staff access

Visitors enter a display name; this is not a verified identity or a private account. Use an appropriate name and do not enter a password, address, student identifier, or other sensitive information in that field.

Staff access is provided only to people authorized by the owner. Keep credentials private and use only the permissions assigned to you. The owner may change or revoke staff access. Browser-local staff controls are not a guarantee of security; shared alert publishing requires separate server verification.

6. Data and storage overview

The current hosted app and its local HTML edition use browser storage to support features and record app activity. This includes:

  • Your entered name, a randomly generated browser device ID, first-seen and visit times, and browser, language, platform, timezone, screen, and viewport details.
  • Interactions inside Basement, such as pages visited and game or proxy links selected. The local activity list keeps up to 500 recent records; this does not provide the owner with a synchronized log from everyone's separate browsers.
  • Profiles, favorites, watchlists, recently opened links, preferences, dismissed alerts, and browser-local staff records. Staff password verifiers are stored instead of plaintext passwords, and passwords are not included in app activity records.
  • Shared alerts and recent alert history stored by the alert service. Owner authentication uses a session cookie and server-side session records; owner sign-in throttling stores a hash derived from the connecting IP address. Dismissing an alert hides it locally, and removing it from display does not immediately erase every retained history record.
  • Cloudflare and other providers receive connection information, such as IP addresses and request details, when they serve the website or its services. External images, media, and destinations can send requests to their own providers when loaded, even before you click a link. Their own privacy terms apply.

Local preferences and records remain until cleared, replaced, or removed by the browser or app. Clearing site data can reset your device ID and remove saved settings and activity on that browser; it does not erase copies held by hosting or external providers. A staff member with access to that browser's staff workspace can view its recorded activity.

If a separately deployed Basement server edition is used, its operator can also receive visitor names, device metadata, connection IP addresses, and activity centrally. That is different from the current Pages edition's browser-local visitor log.

Do not enter sensitive information into names or alerts. Contact the owner for privacy questions, correction or deletion requests, or concerns involving a child. Available responses depend on what information is actually held and applicable requirements. Agreeing to these terms does not waive privacy rights or replace notices or consent required by law.

7. Files you choose to preview

The Files tool previews supported files you select on your device. That preview feature does not upload the selected file to a Basement server. You remain responsible for having permission to open the file and for keeping your own backups. Files you separately send to another website are governed by that website's practices.

8. Updates, internet access, and alerts

Basement.html is a shortcut to the hosted website. The shortcut itself does not rewrite its code or update while closed. The hosted app requires internet; opening or manually refreshing it loads the latest published version available at that address.

While entered, visible, and online, the hosted app normally checks for app releases and shared alerts once per minute from 8:30 a.m. through the 3:20 p.m. minute, daily in your device's local time. Checks pause outside that window, while hidden or offline, and after leaving the app. Connection failures can delay checks. A new release shows a refresh notice instead of automatically replacing your open page.

Alerts are in-app announcements, not an emergency notification system or guaranteed delivery service. They can be delayed, dismissed, expired, or unavailable. Do not rely on them for safety-critical information.

9. Changes, availability, and ending use

Basement currently charges no access fee. External providers can have their own fees or requirements. Hosting limits, outages, browser restrictions, and third-party changes may affect availability.

The owner may update, remove, or temporarily disable features and links, or restrict hosted or staff access to address abuse, security, rights complaints, or operational issues. You may stop using the Service at any time. Keep backups of anything important; browser storage is not a backup service.

10. Service limitations and your rights

To the extent permitted by applicable law, the Service is provided as available, without a promise of uninterrupted access, error-free operation, secure third-party sites, or preservation of locally saved data. The owner is not responsible for third-party services or losses caused by their independent actions to the extent the law allows that limitation.

Nothing in these terms excludes liability, consumer protections, privacy rights, or other remedies that cannot lawfully be excluded. These terms do not require arbitration or waive your right to raise a complaint with an appropriate authority.

11. Changes to these terms

Revised terms will show a new version and effective date in the app. Read them before agreeing and entering after an update. A future version does not silently change what you agreed to for earlier use. If you do not agree to revised terms, stop using the Service.

12. Questions, privacy requests, and rights reports

Contact Eli, the Basement owner, using the email below for questions, privacy or child-data concerns, accessibility issues, and copyright or other rights reports. Identify the relevant page or link and explain the concern. For a rights report, explain your relationship to the rights involved. Do not send passwords, payment details, or sensitive identity documents.

This contact is for ordinary requests and reports, not an emergency service. A report does not automatically establish a violation, and these terms do not promise that every request can be completed immediately.

Owner contact: elong091@rsdmo.org

NOW SHOWING

Open in Drive Preview

YOU’RE IN

Make yourself at home.

Enter your name to explore. Use the sidebar on desktop or the menu and bottom dock on phones. Only staff need a username and password.

Watch

Open Watch to browse movies and shows. Search or use Refine your library for category, type, A–Z, and assigned-rating filters. Unrated titles are hidden from restricted profiles.

Profiles

Watch profiles keep separate favorites, watchlists, recently opened links, and rating limits in this browser. They are separate from visitor names and staff accounts.

Favorites

Tap ★ for Favorites and + for My Watchlist, or use the buttons in title details. Saved favorites opens your Favorites; My Watchlist appears in Watch.

Play

Open title details, then choose Play or Preview to open Google Drive in a new tab. Recently opened tracks links, not playback position inside Drive.

FIND SOMETHING NEW

Choose Surprise me in Watch for a random title. Surprise me options lets you use all allowed titles, the current filters, or titles assigned G / PG.

LINK REVIEW

Broken-link review shows previously flagged catalog links and their recorded results. It does not check links live or provide a report form.

Files

Files previews supported PDFs, images, videos, audio, text, and code locally. Text and code previews are limited to 5 MB; unsupported formats need their original app. This preview does not upload your files.
